name: Adamantine Arrow
description: Mystic warriors who perfect themselves through conflict and defend the Awakened.
descriptionPt: Guerreiros místicos que aperfeiçoam a si mesmos através do conflito e defendem os Despertos.

name: Guardians of the Veil
description: Spies and inquisitors who protect the Mysteries and conceal magic from the unworthy.
descriptionPt: Espiões e inquisidores que protegem os Mistérios e ocultam a magia dos indignos.

name: Mysterium
description: Scholars and explorers devoted to preserving, studying, and understanding magical knowledge.
descriptionPt: Eruditos e exploradores dedicados a preservar, estudar e compreender o conhecimento mágico.

name: Silver Ladder
description: Leaders who seek to unite the Awakened and elevate all humanity through magic.
descriptionPt: Líderes que procuram unir os Despertos e elevar toda a humanidade através da magia.

name: Free Council
description: Modern mages who seek wisdom in human culture, democracy, and innovation.
descriptionPt: Magos modernos que buscam sabedoria na cultura humana, na democracia e na inovação.

name: Seers of the Throne
description: Servants of the Exarchs who impose the Throne's hierarchies upon the Fallen World.
descriptionPt: Servos dos Exarcas que impõem as hierarquias do Trono sobre o mundo Caído.

name: Jnanashakti
description: The Wise study and preserve eternal truth through writing.

name: Mahanizrayani
description: The Wise shepherd souls spiritually through ceremony.

name: Samashti
description: The Wise protect a Fallen World through secrecy.

name: Vajrastra
description: The Wise pursue heroic achievements through weaponry.

name: Ajivaki
description: The Wise are not separate from the people and work through living belief.

name: Arcadian Mysteries
description: Pelasgians who teach that magic invites the greater gods into the world.

name: Karpani
description: Magi who frame magic as a battle between good and evil.

name: Mantra Sadhaki
description: Mantrikis who teach that magic proceeds from enlightened consciousness.

name: Weret-Hekau
description: Hemka who understand magic as divine intervention.

name: Company of the Codex
description: Picaroons who hold that freedom is magical and discipline preserves it.

name: Bay City Marshals
description: Marshals who hold that justice is magical and express it through retaliation.
